objective: Complete the owner-requested Android-only production OTA by displaying one canonical real All-Time/Monthly Points rank card for both member and BUKLOD Official Profile, and enforce existing ad and media-performance protections without adding unsafe SDK/network changes.
productionBaselineEvidence: Latest production main source 859b96d6cc15696fffd6ef33bfaf16f0424c9f67 was inspected and staging Android source 2e7dc3aa69d2362b7b360013ccaac9917c353e2b previously passed full staging server manifest readback. New no-publish production RC Android export at e78d0b1c21e5457c2788ed9f177238e53e88912f passed workflow 43599541088; live production manifest must be re-read and compared by the production publisher.
chosenApproach: One minimal JS Profile render reposition and exact-source tests, preserved ads/media runtime, plus rigorous production test coverage; release via protected PR #811 and frozen Android-only production OTA gate. Reuse get_buklod_points_leaderboard (monthly/all_time, p_limit 10) in an account-scoped, focus-bound UI; validate rank_position, UUID, uniqueness, points and bound timeout; no new database exposure or expensive queries.
selectionRationale: Maintain compatible native package/runtime 1.3.2 and existing authenticated rank RPC; avoid duplicating server calls or changing AdMob live units, cached videos, permissions or database contracts.
alternativeApproaches: Replacing the production APK and native SDK is unnecessary and risks installation changes.
Direct force-push to protected production main is prohibited; use scope-gated reviewed PR and CI instead.
Recalculating ranks from ad revenue would conflate Points standings with finance payouts and misrepresent final earnings.

Ads native inventory and protected placements preserved; sponsored-video near viewport and original-quality cache regression checks execute before production publish.
Old compact-header test expectations replaced only with observed 48px accessible targets, compact 48/56 header and 6/3 compact daily-card spacing; safe-area, notifications and verse retained.
No native/dependency/DB/auth/AdMob unit changes; exclude clinical Health Center and SALIKSIK.
All required objective-scope, unit, TypeScript, no-publish production Android export and final production OTA verification gates pass at exact immutable source SHA.
Production Android-only publish from protected main must have frozen RC hash, manifest readback and original runtime; no web, Play or staged-package contamination.

Monthly and All-Time Top 10 are directly visible under authenticated Profile with actual backend rank_position 1–10, participant name and recorded Points, no synthesized ordering or earnings conflation.
preserveBehaviors: Keep authentic author-only posts, original green Connect, active member privacy, RLS, and signed-in account isolation.
Keep AdMob display safety, passive/native placements, rapid sponsored autoplay and sharp media, PTT/calls, offline recovery and Kingdom.
Keep production package org.mzbministry.buklod, Expo 1.3.2 runtime, existing native ABI and all prior production capabilities.
Never activate Health Center clinical APIs, SALIKSIK backend or retired IGPAT and never publish Expo web or Play under this release.

Only existing authenticated Points leaderboard RPC may supply Top 10; official platform account is excluded by existing database ranking policy; never fabricate a self placement or leak a private scope.
